svg.title: Red Breach onboarding floor plan, revision 03
svg.text: RED BREACH / ONBOARDING — SECURITY INDUCTION, REVISION 03
Drafted from a solid block: spaces are carved out, walls are real thickness and shared. Every room is composed, not reserved.
Draft for discussion. Verticality, lighting and encounters deliberately not on this drawing yet.
17 rooms + 9 corridor legs in a 38 x 24 m block • 620 m² of floor = 67% of the footprint built (admin.map ground story, for comparison: 1,664 m²)
Route through the loop ≈ 108 m → roughly 22 s of pure walking at 5 m/s. Room time (sign-in, armory, range, dispatch) is on top of that.
